TOI + HT + IE, to 2026-08-18, print-edition objects only

coverage_note: Licensed full-text start dates as available at the host institution (Yonsei ProQuest), verified 2026-08-18; GDELT DOC 2.0 floor probed 2026-08-16; Internet Archive coverage measured by CDX enumeration of The Hindu daily section indexes, 2000-2010.

coverage.note: Licensed full text from 2005-01-01. Heavy wire share; provenance is a core variable.
Licensed full text from 2006-01-06. The 2022 count is anomalously low and is treated as a suspected database gap, not a finding.
Licensed full text from 2009-04-23. Own archive hosts are dead; the licensed copy is the only route.
Licensed full text at the host institution begins only in 2015. The live archive is bot-gated and is not bypassed.
Hard floor at 2017-01-01: earlier queries are rejected. Returns URL and title metadata, not full text.
The Hindu daily section indexes, recovered by CDX enumeration. Preservation grows roughly twentyfold across 2000-2008, so density here measures archiving, not publishing.

online_edition_marker.label: Online editions enter the index
online_edition_marker.note: From 2017 the databases index online-only editions alongside print. Counts that mix them are not comparable with earlier years; the project separates print objects from online objects for this reason.

unvalidated_window.note: No licensed full-text source at the host institution covers 2000-2004. That window is unvalidated, not empty.

print_series.source: ProQuest TDM Studio, dataset "Hallyu Indian Press 2006-2026" (5,412 records); print-edition objects only. Online and Blogs objects are excluded because they enter the database in 2017 and would fake a jump exactly where the real one occurs.

anomaly.note: Down from 207 in 2021 and back to 128 in 2023. A fivefold single-year collapse in one paper while the other two rise is more likely a database coverage gap than an editorial decision, and is treated as suspect rather than as evidence.

periodisation.note: Mean print articles per year by block. The inflection is 2018–19, not 2017: 2017 is a local trough at 0.61x the previous year, and the step change comes in two stages, 2018 at 2.74x and 2019 at 3.06x.
